clips.welcome: Welcome. Find a comfortable seat, and let your shoulders drop. Take a slow breath in... and out. Let's begin.
clips.switch_sides: Switch sides. Now the right side.
clips.breath.3: Slow breath in... and a long breath out.
clips.breath.4: Breathe in... and out. Nice and slow.
clips.stay.1: Stay here, and keep breathing slowly.
clips.stay.2: One more round. Stay with your breath.
clips.stay.3: Stay here. Soften a little more with each exhale.
clips.closing: Slowly deepen your breath... Wiggle your fingers and toes... When you are ready, roll to one side... and come up slowly. Thank you for practicing.
clips.yoga_easy.intro: Next, Easy pose. Sit on a folded blanket with your legs loosely crossed at the shins. Rest your hands on your knees.
clips.yoga_easy.again: Easy pose. Sit on a folded blanket with your legs loosely crossed at the shins. Rest your hands on your knees.
clips.yoga_easy.cue: Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders. Breathe slowly.
clips.yoga_easy.cue2: Sit on a cushion until your knees are lower than your hips.
clips.yoga_cat_cow.intro: Next, Cat-cow. Come onto your hands and knees, with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
clips.yoga_cat_cow.again: Cat-cow. Come onto your hands and knees, with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
clips.yoga_cat_cow.cue: Inhale, let your belly drop and lift your chest. Exhale, round your back toward the ceiling.
clips.yoga_cat_cow.cue2: Move slowly, one breath per movement. Press the floor away so your shoulder blades spread.
clips.yoga_childs.intro: Next, Child's pose. Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels, knees apart if that is more comfortable. Fold forward and rest your forehead on the floor.
clips.yoga_childs.again: Child's pose. Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels, knees apart if that is more comfortable. Fold forward and rest your forehead on the floor.
clips.yoga_childs.cue: Let your arms lie forward or alongside your legs. Breathe into your back.
clips.yoga_childs.cue2: Let your shoulders sink away from your ears.
clips.yoga_downward_dog.intro: Next, Downward dog. Come onto your hands and knees, hands shoulder width apart. Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
clips.yoga_downward_dog.again: Downward dog. Come onto your hands and knees, hands shoulder width apart. Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
clips.yoga_downward_dog.cue: Press the floor away and lengthen your spine. Bend your knees as much as you need.
clips.yoga_downward_dog.cue2: Spread your fingers and press through your whole hand.
clips.yoga_low_lunge.intro: Next, Low lunge, left side. From your hands and knees, step one foot forward between your hands. Lower your back knee to the floor.
clips.yoga_low_lunge.again: Low lunge, left side. From your hands and knees, step one foot forward between your hands. Lower your back knee to the floor.
clips.yoga_low_lunge.cue: Sink your hips forward and down, then raise your torso and arms.
clips.yoga_low_lunge.cue2: Keep your front knee over the ankle. Tuck your tailbone slightly so your lower back stays long.
clips.yoga_standing_forward_fold.intro: Next, Standing forward fold. Stand with your feet hip width apart. Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine, and bend your knees as much as you need.
clips.yoga_standing_forward_fold.again: Standing forward fold. Stand with your feet hip width apart. Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine, and bend your knees as much as you need.
clips.yoga_standing_forward_fold.cue: Let your head and arms hang, or hold opposite elbows.
clips.yoga_standing_forward_fold.cue2: Bend your knees rather than rounding hard.
clips.yoga_mountain.intro: Next, Mountain. Stand with your feet hip width apart and your weight even across both feet. Let your arms hang by your sides, palms facing forward.
clips.yoga_mountain.again: Mountain. Stand with your feet hip width apart and your weight even across both feet. Let your arms hang by your sides, palms facing forward.
clips.yoga_mountain.cue: Spread your toes and press evenly through all four corners of each foot. Keep your knees soft, not locked.
clips.yoga_mountain.cue2: Lengthen the crown of your head toward the ceiling, and relax your shoulders away from your ears.
clips.yoga_chair.intro: Next, Chair. Stand with your feet hip width apart. Bend your knees and sit your hips back as if lowering into a chair, then raise your arms alongside your ears.
clips.yoga_chair.again: Chair. Stand with your feet hip width apart. Bend your knees and sit your hips back as if lowering into a chair, then raise your arms alongside your ears.
clips.yoga_chair.cue: Keep your chest lifted. Let your weight sit in your heels.
clips.yoga_chair.cue2: Keep your knees over your ankles, not past your toes.
clips.yoga_warrior_i.intro: Next, Warrior one, left side. Step one foot back about a leg's length and turn the back foot out slightly, heel down. Bend the front knee over the ankle.
clips.yoga_warrior_i.again: Warrior one, left side. Step one foot back about a leg's length and turn the back foot out slightly, heel down. Bend the front knee over the ankle.
clips.yoga_warrior_i.cue: Square your hips toward the front as far as is comfortable, and raise both arms overhead.
clips.yoga_warrior_i.cue2: Keep the front knee in line with your second toe. Lift your chest without arching your lower back.
clips.yoga_warrior_ii.intro: Next, Warrior two, left side. Stand with your feet about a leg's length apart. Turn your front foot out, your back foot slightly in, and bend the front knee over the ankle.
clips.yoga_warrior_ii.again: Warrior two, left side. Stand with your feet about a leg's length apart. Turn your front foot out, your back foot slightly in, and bend the front knee over the ankle.
clips.yoga_warrior_ii.cue: Stretch your arms out level with the floor and look over your front hand.
clips.yoga_warrior_ii.cue2: Stack your shoulders over your hips, not leaning toward the front leg.
clips.yoga_side_angle.intro: Next, Extended side angle, left side. Start in Warrior two with the front knee bent. Lower your front forearm to your front thigh, or your hand to a block.
clips.yoga_side_angle.again: Extended side angle, left side. Start in Warrior two with the front knee bent. Lower your front forearm to your front thigh, or your hand to a block.
clips.yoga_side_angle.cue: Reach the other arm long over your ear.
clips.yoga_side_angle.cue2: Keep the front knee over the ankle. Turn your chest toward the ceiling.
clips.yoga_triangle.intro: Next, Triangle, left side. Stand with your feet about a leg's length apart, front foot turned out. Reach your front arm forward, then tip from your hip and rest that hand on your shin or a block.
clips.yoga_triangle.again: Triangle, left side. Stand with your feet about a leg's length apart, front foot turned out. Reach your front arm forward, then tip from your hip and rest that hand on your shin or a block.
clips.yoga_triangle.cue: Stretch your top arm toward the ceiling.
clips.yoga_triangle.cue2: Keep both legs straight but the knees unlocked. Rest your hand on your shin, not on the knee joint.
clips.yoga_tree.intro: Next, Tree, left side. Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot. Place the other foot on your calf or inner thigh, never on the knee.
clips.yoga_tree.again: Tree, left side. Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot. Place the other foot on your calf or inner thigh, never on the knee.
clips.yoga_tree.cue: Bring your palms together at your chest, or raise them overhead.
clips.yoga_tree.cue2: Fix your eyes on one still point. Press the foot and leg into each other.
clips.yoga_locust.intro: Next, Locust. Lie face down with your arms by your sides and your forehead on the floor. Lift your head, chest and arms a little off the floor.
clips.yoga_locust.again: Locust. Lie face down with your arms by your sides and your forehead on the floor. Lift your head, chest and arms a little off the floor.
clips.yoga_locust.cue2: Lift only as high as stays comfortable in your lower back.
clips.yoga_sphinx.intro: Next, Sphinx. Lie face down and bring your forearms to the floor, with your elbows under your shoulders. Press your forearms down and lift your chest.
clips.yoga_sphinx.again: Sphinx. Lie face down and bring your forearms to the floor, with your elbows under your shoulders. Press your forearms down and lift your chest.
clips.yoga_sphinx.cue: Keep your legs relaxed and your hips on the floor.
clips.yoga_sphinx.cue2: Keep your shoulders away from your ears. Stop where you feel a gentle arch, never a pinch.
clips.yoga_cobra.intro: Next, Cobra. Lie face down with your palms under your shoulders and your elbows tucked in. Press your pubic bone and the tops of your feet into the floor.
clips.yoga_cobra.again: Cobra. Lie face down with your palms under your shoulders and your elbows tucked in. Press your pubic bone and the tops of your feet into the floor.
clips.yoga_cobra.cue: Peel your head and chest up, using your back muscles more than your hands.
clips.yoga_cobra.cue2: Keep your elbows bent and close to your ribs. Keep your neck long.
clips.yoga_bridge.intro: Next, Bridge. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet hip width apart, close to your hips. Press your feet down and lift your hips.
clips.yoga_bridge.again: Bridge. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet hip width apart, close to your hips. Press your feet down and lift your hips.
clips.yoga_bridge.cue: Keep your arms by your sides and your knees over your ankles.
clips.yoga_bridge.cue2: Squeeze your glutes rather than arching your lower back. Keep your neck relaxed.
clips.yoga_happy_baby.intro: Next, Happy baby. Lie on your back and bring your knees toward your armpits. Hold the outsides of your feet or your shins.
clips.yoga_happy_baby.again: Happy baby. Lie on your back and bring your knees toward your armpits. Hold the outsides of your feet or your shins.
clips.yoga_happy_baby.cue: Let your knees open wide and gently pull them toward the floor.
clips.yoga_happy_baby.cue2: Keep your head and tailbone on the floor.
clips.yoga_knees_to_chest.intro: Next, Knees to chest. Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest. Hold your shins, or hug your knees with both arms.
clips.yoga_knees_to_chest.again: Knees to chest. Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest. Hold your shins, or hug your knees with both arms.
clips.yoga_knees_to_chest.cue: Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
clips.yoga_knees_to_chest.cue2: Hold under the knees rather than pulling on the kneecaps.
clips.yoga_staff.intro: Next, Staff. Sit with your legs straight in front of you and your feet flexed. Press your palms into the floor beside your hips.
clips.yoga_staff.again: Staff. Sit with your legs straight in front of you and your feet flexed. Press your palms into the floor beside your hips.
clips.yoga_staff.cue: Sit tall, lifting through the crown of your head.
clips.yoga_staff.cue2: Keep your thighs gently pressing down.
clips.yoga_seated_forward_fold.intro: Next, Seated forward fold. Sit with your legs straight, and your knees slightly bent if needed. Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine.
clips.yoga_seated_forward_fold.again: Seated forward fold. Sit with your legs straight, and your knees slightly bent if needed. Hinge forward from your hips with a long spine.
clips.yoga_seated_forward_fold.cue: Hold your shins, ankles or feet.
clips.yoga_seated_forward_fold.cue2: Lead with your chest, not your head. Keep a soft bend in your knees.
clips.yoga_butterfly.intro: Next, Butterfly. Sit tall and bring the soles of your feet together, with your knees falling out to the sides. Hold your feet or ankles.
clips.yoga_butterfly.again: Butterfly. Sit tall and bring the soles of your feet together, with your knees falling out to the sides. Hold your feet or ankles.
clips.yoga_butterfly.cue: Lengthen your spine and let your knees lower on their own.
clips.yoga_butterfly.cue2: Never push your knees down with your hands.
clips.yoga_seated_twist.intro: Next, Seated twist, left side. Sit with your legs straight, then cross one foot over the opposite thigh with the knee up. Hug that knee with the opposite arm, or place your elbow outside it.
clips.yoga_seated_twist.again: Seated twist, left side. Sit with your legs straight, then cross one foot over the opposite thigh with the knee up. Hug that knee with the opposite arm, or place your elbow outside it.
clips.yoga_seated_twist.cue: Press the other hand into the floor behind you and sit tall. Turn gently from your ribs.
clips.yoga_seated_twist.cue2: Lengthen your spine on each inhale and twist on each exhale.
clips.yoga_legs_up_wall.intro: Next, Legs up the wall. Sit sideways beside a wall with one hip touching it. Swing your legs up the wall as you lower your back to the floor.
clips.yoga_legs_up_wall.again: Legs up the wall. Sit sideways beside a wall with one hip touching it. Swing your legs up the wall as you lower your back to the floor.
clips.yoga_legs_up_wall.cue: Shuffle your hips close to the wall, bending your knees if your hamstrings pull.
clips.yoga_legs_up_wall.cue2: Rest your arms by your sides and breathe slowly.
clips.yoga_corpse.intro: Next, Corpse. Lie on your back with your legs hip width apart and your feet falling open. Rest your arms a little away from your sides, palms up.
clips.yoga_corpse.again: Corpse. Lie on your back with your legs hip width apart and your feet falling open. Rest your arms a little away from your sides, palms up.
clips.yoga_corpse.cue: Close your eyes and let your body feel heavy. Breathe naturally and let go of effort.
clips.yoga_corpse.cue2: Put a pillow under your knees if your lower back is tight.
clips.cal.welcome: Let's go! No equipment, just you. On rep exercises, go at your own pace and tap done when you finish. On holds, I'll count you down. First up, the warm-up.
clips.cal.rest.1: Shake it out and catch your breath.
clips.cal.rest.2: Slow breath in, long breath out.
clips.cal.rest.3: Nice work. Get some water if you need it.
clips.cal.closing: That's the workout. Great job today! Slow your breathing, and take a minute before you move on.
clips.cal.n.screen: Your target is on the screen.
clips.cal.knee_push_up.name: knee push-ups.
clips.cal.knee_push_up.intro: Knee push-ups. Hands a little wider than your shoulders, knees on the floor, body in one line from head to knees.
clips.cal.knee_push_up.cue: Elbows back about forty-five degrees, and chest to the floor.
clips.cal.knee_push_up.reps: knee push-ups, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.push_up.name: push-ups.
clips.cal.push_up.intro: Push-ups. Hands a little wider than your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.
clips.cal.push_up.cue: Elbows back, chest low, core tight.
clips.cal.push_up.reps: push-ups, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.air_squat.name: squats.
clips.cal.air_squat.intro: Squats. Feet shoulder width apart, toes slightly out. Sit your hips back and keep your chest up.
clips.cal.air_squat.cue: Heels down, and knees over your toes.
clips.cal.air_squat.reps: squats, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.glute_bridge.name: glute bridges.
clips.cal.glute_bridge.intro: Glute bridges. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Drive your hips up.
clips.cal.glute_bridge.cue: Squeeze your glutes at the top.
clips.cal.glute_bridge.reps: glute bridges, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.crunch.name: crunches.
clips.cal.crunch.intro: Crunches. On your back, knees bent, hands beside your head. Curl your shoulders up.
clips.cal.crunch.cue: Slow and smooth, and do not pull on your neck.
clips.cal.crunch.reps: crunches, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.lunge.name: lunges.
clips.cal.lunge.intro: Lunges. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about ninety degrees.
clips.cal.lunge.cue: Front knee over your ankle, and torso tall.
clips.cal.lunge.reps: lunges on this side, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.split_squat.name: split squats.
clips.cal.split_squat.intro: Split squats. Feet in a long stance. Lower straight down, then drive back up.
clips.cal.split_squat.cue: Chest tall, and front heel down.
clips.cal.split_squat.reps: split squats on this side, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.pike_push_up.name: pike push-ups.
clips.cal.pike_push_up.intro: Pike push-ups. Hips high, like an upside-down V. Lower the top of your head toward the floor.
clips.cal.pike_push_up.cue: Elbows back, and legs as straight as you can.
clips.cal.pike_push_up.reps: pike push-ups, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.burpee.name: burpees.
clips.cal.burpee.intro: Burpees. Squat, hands down, feet back to a plank, chest down. Then jump up with your arms overhead.
clips.cal.burpee.cue: Land soft, and step it if you need to.
clips.cal.burpee.reps: burpees, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.decline_push_up.name: decline push-ups.
clips.cal.decline_push_up.intro: Decline push-ups. Feet up on a sturdy step, hands on the floor, body in one line.
clips.cal.decline_push_up.cue: Core tight, and chest to the floor.
clips.cal.decline_push_up.reps: decline push-ups, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.jump_squat.name: jump squats.
clips.cal.jump_squat.intro: Jump squats. Squat down, then explode up and land softly.
clips.cal.jump_squat.cue: Land quietly, with your knees over your toes.
clips.cal.jump_squat.reps: jump squats, at your own pace. Tap done when you finish.
clips.cal.jumping_jack.name: jumping jacks.
clips.cal.jumping_jack.intro: Jumping jacks. Stand tall with your feet together. Jump your feet wide as your arms swing overhead.
clips.cal.jumping_jack.cue: Land softly, and keep a steady rhythm.
clips.cal.mountain_climber.name: mountain climbers.
clips.cal.mountain_climber.intro: Mountain climbers. Get into a high plank, hands under your shoulders, body in one line.
clips.cal.mountain_climber.cue: Drive those knees, and keep your hips level.
clips.cal.wall_sit.name: the wall sit.
clips.cal.wall_sit.intro: Wall sit. Back against the wall. Slide down until your knees are bent to ninety degrees.
clips.cal.wall_sit.cue: Keep your back flat on the wall, and breathe.
clips.cal.plank.name: the plank.
clips.cal.plank.intro: Plank. Forearms down, elbows under your shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels.
clips.cal.plank.cue: Squeeze your glutes, and don't let your hips sag.
clips.cal.side_plank.name: the side plank.
clips.cal.side_plank.intro: Side plank. On your side, propped on your forearm. Lift your hips into a straight line.
clips.cal.side_plank.cue: Stack your feet, and keep your hips high.
clips.cal.hollow_hold.name: the hollow hold.
clips.cal.hollow_hold.intro: Hollow hold. On your back, arms overhead. Press your lower back down, and lift your shoulders and legs.
clips.cal.hollow_hold.cue: Keep your lower back glued to the floor.
clips.cal.cat_stretch.name: the cat stretch.
clips.cal.cat_stretch.intro: Cat stretch. On your hands and knees, tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
clips.cal.childs_pose.name: child's pose.
clips.cal.childs_pose.intro: Child's pose. Walk your hands forward, sit your hips back to your heels, and rest your forehead down.
clips.cal.kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.name: the hip flexor stretch.
clips.cal.kneeling_hip_flexor_stretch.intro: Kneeling hip flexor stretch. One foot forward, back knee down. Tuck your tailbone and shift forward.
clips.cal.seated_hamstring_stretch.name: the hamstring stretch.
clips.cal.seated_hamstring_stretch.intro: Seated hamstring stretch. One leg straight in front. Hinge forward from your hips.
clips.cal.cross_body_shoulder_stretch.name: the shoulder stretch.
clips.cal.cross_body_shoulder_stretch.intro: Cross-body shoulder stretch. Pull one arm across your chest, and hold it with the other.
